gloss: death from illness; dying of disease

definitions.gloss: death from illness; dying of disease
definitions.explanation: Death caused by illness or disease, as opposed to death by accident, violence, or old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{病死|びょうし}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{病死|びょうし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cause of death was determined to be illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦死|せんし}→戦死：12979_senshi⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{栄養|えいよう}{失調|しっちょう}→栄養失調：21221_eiyoushicchou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{病死|びょうし}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: During the war, there were many deaths not only from combat but also from illness caused by malnutrition.

notes:
A formal term used in official, medical, and legal contexts to classify the manner of death. Often contrasted with other causes of death such as ⟦{事故死|じこし}→事故死：23678_jikoshi⟧ (accidental death) or ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧ (suicide).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病死|びょうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to die of illness
- {病死|びょうし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be classified as death from illness
- ⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{病死|びょうし}: the cause of death is illness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {病没|びょうぼつ}: death from illness — more literary or formal; often used for notable figures
- ⟦{事故死|じこし}→事故死：23678_jikoshi⟧: accidental death — death caused by an accident
- ⟦{戦死|せんし}→戦死：12979_senshi⟧: death in battle — killed in combat
- ⟦{老衰|ろうすい}→老衰：13982_rousui⟧: death from old age — natural death due to aging
- ⟦{急死|きゅうし}→急死：18189_kyuushi⟧: sudden death — dying suddenly and unexpectedly
